answer: At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a sonnet tag. The oasis cap is upheld at intake and dune makes public the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
